# A run records what it learned in testdata, so the next run only has to
# try the actions that changed.
#
# An action is identified by its source together with the types resolved
# for it and the seed the values were drawn from. The source alone is not
# enough: a field changing from a string to an int changes what a mutation
# substitutes without changing a byte of the template, and the dot type's
# name stays the same either way.
#
# The first run tries everything and writes the file. The second reuses
# every verdict. Editing the template changes that action's fingerprint,
# so its mutants are tried again while the untouched template's are not.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-first.txt
exists testdata/template-mutations.json

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-reused.txt

cp changed.txt templates.gohtml
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmp stdout want-changed.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
{{define "farewell"}}Bye, {{.Name}}.{{end}}
-- changed.txt --
{{define "greeting"}}Howdy, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
{{define "farewell"}}Bye, {{.Name}}.{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}

func Farewell(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "farewell", page)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(buf.String(), "World") {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q", buf.String())
	}
}

func TestFarewell(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Farewell(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(buf.String(), "World") {
		t.Errorf("farewell = %q", buf.String())
	}
}
-- want-first.txt --
2 mutants across 2 templates (complexity 2, seed 1)
baseline ok

2 mutants, 2 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped
-- want-reused.txt --
2 mutants across 2 templates (complexity 2, seed 1)
baseline ok

2 mutants, 2 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped, 2 reused
-- want-changed.txt --
2 mutants across 2 templates (complexity 2, seed 1)
baseline ok

2 mutants, 2 killed, 0 missed, 0 skipped, 1 reused
